$comment: Manifest of AI upscale model files fetched by `npm run setup:models`. Each entry lands at `public/models/<filename>` and is served by Vite at `/models/<filename>`. EDIT URLS to point at working ONNX exports; the optional `expectedSize` + `sha256` fields are verified after download (leave null to skip). If a URL is unreachable or auth-gated (Hugging Face often requires auth for model downloads), drop the file at `public/models/<filename>` manually instead — the download script + Settings UI both detect manually-installed files.

models.description: Real-ESRGAN x4 Anime ONNX export — accepts 8×8 RGB input, produces 32×32 RGB output. Source up to you: https://openmodeldb.info/ has many trained variants; community ONNX conversions are scattered across Hugging Face + GitHub releases. Until a stable public URL is locked in here, install the file manually at public/models/realesrgan-x4-anime.onnx.
models.manualInstallNote: Find any Real-ESRGAN x4 Anime ONNX export (e.g. from https://openmodeldb.info/m/x4-Real-ESRGAN-Anime, then convert with onnxruntime tools), drop it at public/models/realesrgan-x4-anime.onnx, and reload.
